title: A default area for each list
items: A list can have a default area. Pick one under Default area in the list's settings, and an item that matches no keyword goes there rather than being left uncategorised.
The default belongs to the list, so everyone sharing it gets the same one, and it applies to items added from a public link and the Android app as well.

title: Backups, named lists and remembered amounts
items: "New list" asks for a name before it makes the list, and Share list is in each list's menu in the sidebar.
Back up your lists to a file and restore them, under Backup in Settings.
Add "500 g Rice" once and next time "Rice" on its own comes back as 500 g Rice. The amount belongs to the list, so everyone sharing it gets the same one.
Adding something that is already ticked off brings it back to the list rather than adding a second one.
More units are understood when typed with an amount: pc, pcs, pkg, dag, dkg, jar, tub, pot and leaf, and Stk in German.
This window, which shows what has changed after an update. What's new in Settings opens it again.

title: Your own list order, invite codes and names on items
items: Lists can be sorted A to Z or dragged into your own order. Choose Sort lists in Settings at the bottom of the list sidebar, and the order follows you to every browser and the Android app.
A shared list's public link now has a short invite code and a QR code in the Share dialog, so someone without a Nextcloud account can join the list in the Android app.
Each item shows who added it and who ticked it. People on a public link can type their name, which shows as "Anna (guest)".
